scope: Offline-only real-tensor falsifier. It cannot modify serving output or authorize a lossy production path.
randomness: Obtain one three-relay-agreed, BLS-verified drand round only after the scorer, tests, plan, and source hashes freeze. Derive independent per-layer key/query permutations and 512 random Hadamard signs with domain-separated SHA-256 seeds.

split.rule: Exact seeded permutations split keys 4096/4096 and query positions 64/64 per layer. Correction parameters use calibration keys only. Metrics use held-out queries and only selected held-out key IDs.

quantizer.scale: continuous F32 amax/6 independently for every 32-value key-row block
quantizer.interpretation: This optimistic scale is a lower-error bound for deployable quantized scales. Failure stops the branch; passing only justifies a later exact packed-format and NLL gate.

rotation: One seeded orthonormal 512-wide Walsh-Hadamard transform with seeded sign flips per layer, applied identically to keys and queries.
correction: Per-layer, per-channel alpha=sum(reference*quantized)/sum(quantized^2), fitted on calibration keys only and applied after rotated E2M1 quantization.
metric: sqrt(sum((q dot (candidate_k-reference_k))^2) / sum((q dot reference_k)^2)) over every held-out query head and every valid selected held-out key; accumulate numerator and denominator in F64.
acceptance_formula: PASS iff all source hashes/shapes/dtypes/counts/finiteness/split checks pass, every layer contributes held-out pairs and positive denominator, and at least one preregistered candidate has aggregate query-weighted relative RMSE <= 0.05. Otherwise FAIL and stop W9 before kernel work.
post_pass_rule: A PASS does not authorize adoption. It only authorizes an exact packed-format implementation followed by the fixed 100-case paired NLL/top-1 gate and owner review of any nonzero fidelity loss.
resource_bound: CPU/Numpy only; memory-map the 276.8 MB capture, process one layer and one candidate at a time, and never start the GLM engine.
